records.title: Looped Transformers under the Jacobian Lens: Does the Global Workspace Survive Recurrence?
records.reason: Virtual unrolling and mean-Jacobian probes/interventions test global-workspace behavior in recurrent transformers. Qwen and looped-model experiments are analyzed; limitations identify the linearized single-token lens and validated horizon. This is mechanistic analysis, not inference-efficiency technique.

records.title: Vinci2: Providing Proactive Assistance in Continuous Egocentric Videos
records.reason: Vinci2 combines proactive query timing with EgoMemo text memory for continuous egocentric-video assistance; experiments assess assistance behavior. Limitations note that captions lose fine visual detail and entity resolution can fail. No inference-cost reduction is demonstrated.

records.title: Vidu S1: A Real-Time Interactive Video Generation Model
records.reason: Vidu S1 is a real-time interactive video diffusion model with TurboDiffusion/TurboServe worker and serving stack; paper reports compute/memory savings and up to 42 FPS at 540p. Method/evaluation concern video diffusion, not LLM inference; transfer is unclear.

records.title: OrderGrad: Optimizing Beyond the Mean with Order-Statistic Policy Gradient Estimation
records.reason: OrderGrad develops policy-gradient estimators for order-statistic objectives and evaluates LLM math-reasoning pass@k. It changes training objectives for tail/best-of-K outcomes; no direct inference-compute or serving-cost reduction is established.

records.title: AgentOdyssey: Open-Ended Long-Horizon Text Game Generation for Test-Time Continual Learning Agents
records.reason: Test-time continual-learning agent benchmark, not an inference-efficiency method.
